articles.title: US calls for new Europe security at Russia-Ukraine talks
articles.description: A first day of US-led talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi ended Tuesday, with Washington calling for a "new" security framework, as Europe fears US President Donald Trump plans a deal with Moscow on the continent's future. Negotiations to end more than four years of war -- the first since February -- lasted for several hours in the Gulf city and are set to continue Wednesday. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators sat facing each other, with Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner and business partner Steve Witkoff at the head of the table.
